headline: BDO Network Bank Appoints Alberto Quiogue as President
summary: BDO Network Bank, the thrift banking arm of BDO Unibank, announced that Alberto Quiogue will take over as president following Jesus Antonio Itchon's retirement.
why: Executive leadership transitions at major banking subsidiaries impact institutional strategy and operational continuity.
